sourceKind: Reconstructed release source snapshot verified against the existing installer application payload; not a claim of the original build-time Git commit.

reconstruction.rawSource: Historical TypeScript source restored for the pre-update learning preparation behavior.
reconstruction.styles: Five original Tailwind scan candidates are explicitly retained without adding unrelated community development tests.

dependencyResolution: Verification uses the pinned installed dependency toolchain; preserveSymlinks is enabled only for the isolated dependency junction to retain normal package paths.
limits: No claim of byte-for-byte reproducibility of the complete NSIS installer, including timestamps and compression metadata.
Prebuilt local service binaries and model/player dependencies were compared as packaged resources, not rebuilt from their upstream source in this verification.
The package lock and separately provisioned local binary/model resources are required for a complete installer build.
